rules.title: #question-header h1
rules.notes: A question page is not an article: it is a question and up to hundreds of answers by different people. Concatenating the bodies, which this rule used to do, produced a wall of text with no way to tell where one answer ended or who wrote it. The author selector takes the LAST post-signature deliberately — the first is the editor, so without :last-of-type a heavily edited answer is attributed to whoever last touched it.
